verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform for software platforms, so the question of where in-flight and held funds sit, whether they earn yield, and how they are segregated is a fair one to ask. The evidence covers only payout speed and batch-close settlement timing. Nothing documents where funds are held, any FBO or segregated accounts, or yield on balances, so there is no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, platform funds have a home — clarity on where in-flight and held funds sit, whether balances earn yield, and how money is segregated from the provider's own accounts
